Cloud-powered

Your church data, safe & accessible anywhere

No more paper registers or scattered spreadsheets. ChurchTrack stores all your member records securely in the cloud — accessible from any phone, tablet or computer, anytime.

  • Real-time sync across all devices simultaneously
  • Works on any phone or computer — no installation needed
  • Data backed up automatically — never lose a record
  • Secure login protects your data from unauthorised access
  • Installable as an app on your phone for quick access
See live demo →

Instant attendance. Safer Sundays.

Mark attendance for every worker and member in seconds — with timestamps showing exactly when each person checked in.

✦ Smarter record keeping
Member Registry

Every member's details, perfectly organised

Store complete profiles for every worker and member — name, phone, email, gender, birthday, marital status, department and rank. Find anyone in seconds.

  • Separate sections for Workers and Members
  • Worker ranks — Pastor, Minister, HOD, Choir, Ushering and more
  • Filter by department, gender, marital status or student status
  • Search by name, phone or email instantly
  • Edit or update profiles from any device at any time
📧 Email · 💬 WhatsApp · 📱 SMS
Communication

Reach your congregation instantly

Send emails, WhatsApp messages and SMS to your entire congregation or specific groups — all from one place. Birthday greetings and welcome messages go out automatically.

  • Auto birthday greetings sent on each member's special day
  • Auto welcome email when a new member is added
  • Broadcast to all, workers only, members only or by rank
  • Absent checkup — reach members who missed service
  • HOD messages — email all heads of department at once
  • Attendance report sent directly to the Pastor
All features

Everything your church needs

From Sunday attendance to birthday greetings — ChurchTrack handles it all.

📋

Smart Attendance

Time-stamped check-in for workers. Separate tracking for workers and members. Full attendance history always available.

👥

Member Registry

Full profiles — name, phone, email, gender, birthday, marital status, department and rank. Always perfectly organised.

📧

Email Centre

Welcome, broadcast, absent checkup, HOD messages and attendance reports. Save email templates for reuse anytime.

💬

WhatsApp Messaging

One-click WhatsApp to any member. Pre-filled greeting, welcome, absent checkup and birthday message templates.

📱

SMS Alerts

Send SMS to individuals or bulk SMS to your congregation through Nigeria's leading SMS platform, Termii.

🎂

Auto Birthday Greetings

The system automatically sends birthday messages every morning. Absolutely zero manual effort required.

🔄

Real-time Cloud Sync

Update on one phone, see it on another instantly. Perfect for churches with multiple admins across locations.

🔐

Secure Login

Password-protected access ensures only authorised church admins can view and manage your church data.

📊

Attendance Reports

Auto-generate full attendance summaries and email them directly to the Pastor with a single click.
